#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import os
import sys

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def create_cover(path):
    """Create a letter-sized cover page PDF with the title and today's date."""
    width, height = letter
    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")

    c = canvas.Canvas(path, pagesize=letter)
    # Title
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 + 30, TITLE)
    # Date
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2.0, height / 2.0 - 30, date_str)
    c.save()
    return date_str


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    date_str = create_cover(COVER_PDF)
    print(f"Created {COVER_PDF} with title '{TITLE}' and date '{date_str}'")

    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    print(f"report.pdf contains {len(report_reader.pages)} page(s)")

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} page(s)")

    # Validate: reopen the output and check page count + first-page text.
    out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    assert len(out_reader.pages) == len(report_reader.pages) + 1, "page count mismatch"
    first_text = out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, f"title not found on cover page: {first_text!r}"
    assert date_str in first_text, f"date not found on cover page: {first_text!r}"
    print("Validation OK: cover page contains title and date; total pages =",
          len(out_reader.pages))
    print("Cover page text preview:")
    print("---")
    print(first_text.strip())
    print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf.

Uses pypdf (pure-PDF content stream, standard Helvetica font) with a
PyMuPDF fallback, then merges the cover ahead of the original report and
validates the result.
"""
import datetime
import os
import sys

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"
TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612.0, 792.0  # US Letter (points)

# Helvetica widths (per 1000 units, AFM standard 14 font metrics)
HELVETICA_WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015, "A": 667, "B": 667,
    "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 667, "G": 722, "H": 722, "I": 667,
    "J": 667, "K": 722, "L": 667, "M": 889, "N": 722, "O": 722, "P": 667,
    "Q": 722, "R": 667, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944,
    "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469,
    "_": 556, "`": 333, "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556,
    "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500,
    "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}


def text_width_pt(text, font_size):
    units = sum(HELVETICA_WIDTHS.get(ch, 556) for ch in text)
    return units / 1000.0 * font_size


def escape_pdf_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def create_cover_pypdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Create cover.pdf using pypdf with a hand-built content stream."""
    from pypdf import PdfWriter
    from pypdf.generic import DecodedStreamObject, DictionaryObject, NameObject

    writer = PdfWriter()
    page = writer.add_blank_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)

    # Standard Type1 Helvetica needs no embedding.
    font = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
    })
    resources = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): font})
    })
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources

    title_size = 28
    date_size = 16
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width_pt(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width_pt(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
    title_y = PAGE_H / 2.0 + 30
    date_y = PAGE_H / 2.0 - 30

    content = (
        "q\n"
        f"BT /F1 {title_size} Tf {title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({escape_pdf_text(title)}) Tj ET\n"
        f"BT /F1 {date_size} Tf {date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({escape_pdf_text(date_str)}) Tj ET\n"
        "Q\n"
    )

    stream = DecodedStreamObject()
    stream.set_data(content.encode("latin-1"))
    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = stream

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)


def create_cover_fitz(path, title, date_str):
    """Fallback: create cover.pdf using PyMuPDF if available."""
    import fitz  # PyMuPDF

    doc = fitz.open()
    page = doc.new_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)
    page.insert_text(
        (PAGE_W / 2, PAGE_H / 2 + 30), title,
        fontname="helv", fontsize=28, morph=None,
    )
    # PyMuPDF insert_text starts at the baseline; compute center via font metrics.
    tw = fitz.get_text_length(title, fontname="helv", fontsize=28)
    page.insert_text((PAGE_W / 2 - tw / 2, PAGE_H / 2 + 30), title,
                     fontname="helv", fontsize=28)
    tw2 = fitz.get_text_length(date_str, fontname="helv", fontsize=16)
    page.insert_text((PAGE_W / 2 - tw2 / 2, PAGE_H / 2 - 30), date_str,
                     fontname="helv", fontsize=16)
    doc.save(path)
    doc.close()


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Cover title: '{TITLE}' | date: '{date_str}'")

    backend = None
    try:
        create_cover_pypdf(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
        backend = "pypdf"
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        try:
            create_cover_fitz(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
            backend = "pymupdf"
        except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
            print(f"ERROR: no usable PDF library (pypdf missing: {exc})",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Created {COVER_PDF} via {backend}")

    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    print(f"{INPUT_PDF} contains {len(report_reader.pages)} page(s)")

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} page(s)")

    # Validation
    out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    assert len(out_reader.pages) == len(report_reader.pages) + 1, \
        "page count mismatch"
    first_text = out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, f"title not on cover: {first_text!r}"
    assert date_str in first_text, f"date not on cover: {first_text!r}"
    print("Validation OK: cover page has title and date; total pages =",
          len(out_reader.pages))
    print("Cover page text preview:")
    print("---")
    print(first_text.strip())
    print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def create_cover_pypdf(path, title, date_str):
    """Create cover.pdf using pypdf with a hand-built content stream."""
    from pypdf import PdfWriter
    from pypdf.generic import DecodedStreamObject, DictionaryObject, NameObject

    writer = PdfWriter()
    page = writer.add_blank_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)

    # Standard Type1 Helvetica needs no embedding.
    font = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Type"): NameObject("/Font"),
        NameObject("/Subtype"): NameObject("/Type1"),
        NameObject("/BaseFont"): NameObject("/Helvetica"),
    })
    resources = DictionaryObject({
        NameObject("/Font"): DictionaryObject({NameObject("/F1"): font})
    })
    page[NameObject("/Resources")] = resources

    title_size = 28
    date_size = 16
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width_pt(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width_pt(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
    title_y = PAGE_H / 2.0 + 30
    date_y = PAGE_H / 2.0 - 30

    content = (
        "q\n"
        f"BT /F1 {title_size} Tf {title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({escape_pdf_text(title)}) Tj ET\n"
        f"BT /F1 {date_size} Tf {date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({escape_pdf_text(date_str)}) Tj ET\n"
        "Q\n"
    )

    stream = DecodedStreamObject()
    stream.set_data(content.encode("latin-1"))
    page[NameObject("/Contents")] = stream

    with open(path, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)


def create_cover_fitz(path, title, date_str):
    """Fallback: create cover.pdf using PyMuPDF if available."""
    import fitz  # PyMuPDF

    doc = fitz.open()
    page = doc.new_page(width=PAGE_W, height=PAGE_H)
    page.insert_text(
        (PAGE_W / 2, PAGE_H / 2 + 30), title,
        fontname="helv", fontsize=28, morph=None,
    )
    # PyMuPDF insert_text starts at the baseline; compute center via font metrics.
    tw = fitz.get_text_length(title, fontname="helv", fontsize=28)
    page.insert_text((PAGE_W / 2 - tw / 2, PAGE_H / 2 + 30), title,
                     fontname="helv", fontsize=28)
    tw2 = fitz.get_text_length(date_str, fontname="helv", fontsize=16)
    page.insert_text((PAGE_W / 2 - tw2 / 2, PAGE_H / 2 - 30), date_str,
                     fontname="helv", fontsize=16)
    doc.save(path)
    doc.close()


def main():
    if not os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF):
        print(f"ERROR: {INPUT_PDF} not found in workspace", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Cover title: '{TITLE}' | date: '{date_str}'")

    backend = None
    try:
        create_cover_pypdf(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
        backend = "pypdf"
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        try:
            create_cover_fitz(COVER_PDF, TITLE, date_str)
            backend = "pymupdf"
        except ModuleNotFoundError as exc:
            print(f"ERROR: no usable PDF library (pypdf missing: {exc})",
                  file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Created {COVER_PDF} via {backend}")

    from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

    cover_reader = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)
    report_reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    print(f"{INPUT_PDF} contains {len(report_reader.pages)} page(s)")

    writer = PdfWriter()
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in report_reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Wrote {OUTPUT_PDF} with {len(writer.pages)} page(s)")

    # Validation
    out_reader = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    assert len(out_reader.pages) == len(report_reader.pages) + 1, \
        "page count mismatch"
    first_text = out_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    assert TITLE in first_text, f"title not on cover: {first_text!r}"
    assert date_str in first_text, f"date not on cover: {first_text!r}"
    print("Validation OK: cover page has title and date; total pages =",
          len(out_reader.pages))
    print("Cover page text preview:")
    print("---")
    print(first_text.strip())
    print("---")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
